articles.title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
articles.snippet: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

articles.title: Clarity Act's odds of passing plunge as Republicans reject Democrats' counter-proposal
articles.snippet: Prediction markets sharply marked down the crypto market structure bill’s near-term prospects as negotiations remained stuck hours before a key Senate vote.

articles.title: Why banks should stop worrying and learn to love the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: They could be the biggest winners from regulatory clarity, argues Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets.

articles.title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC plans to acquire a gold dealer for $16 million to fund bitcoin buy
articles.snippet: The proposed acquisition would use cash flow from precious metals sales to build bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Hong Kong crypto exchange CoinEx to cease operations after 9 years in business
articles.snippet: Founder and CEO Haipo Yang cited mounting security and compliance risks and said he rejected a sale in favor of a “clean ending.”
